detail: After the Greeks take Troy with the Trojan Horse, the Trojan prince Aeneas escapes and flees to Italy. Roman legend makes him an ancestor of Romulus, and Julius Caesar's family claimed descent from his son Iulus.
label: c. 1184 BCE (traditional)
note: Date added: the traditional date for the fall of Troy, from the Greek scholar Eratosthenes. This is legend, not recorded history.
title: Aeneas escapes the fall of Troy
